The '''Gondola Speeder''', also known simply as a '''water speeder''', was a handcrafted [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] used as a lake barge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloted]] by [[Paddy Accu/Legends|Paddy Accu]], the speeder was utilized by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to reach [[Naberrie family/Legends|her family]] lake retreat, [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|We were going out to the island.''"<br />"''Oh, I'll get you there!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Paddy Accu/Legends|Paddy Accu]]|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
The Gondola Speeder was one of the elegant vessels used in the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]], and exemplified the balance between aesthetic and environment the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] sought in the exploitation of their [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] natural resources. While other lakeside communities and traders used slow-moving, paddle-wheel barges or [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], the craftsmen working near [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] hand-crafted the Gondola Speeder as a variant of the larger lake barges. This was a smaller, uncomplicated vessel that afforded its passengers a relaxed journey.<ref name="FF87" />

An environmentally friendly craft, the homegrown Gondola Speeder was slim, practical, and compact. The single front seat accommodated the vessel's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], who steered via a navigation wheel, and three seats allowed for three adult passengers behind, although this space was usually reserved for luggage. With only a pilot aboard, the Gondola Speeder could achieve a maximum flight ceiling of two [[Meter/Legends|meters]], allowing its use in all but the stormiest of weather. Although it typically hovered above the water, the speeder also functioned as a watercraft. In this mode, its top speed of a little over one hundred [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]] was curtailed. The vessel kept engine baffling components to a minimum, resulting in a craft that was not altogether quiet, but was not too noisy to prevent conversation among its passengers.<ref name="FF87" />

The vessel's sleek hull was not armored, although if holed the pilot could raise it out of the water to prevent sinking. Floats could be deployed in an emergency, and the pilot had access to a communicator on the control panel, collapsible paddles, and emergency flares under the rear passenger seat. The craft's engine was located fore of the pilot, while the downthrusters protruded from the vessel's curved stern.<ref name="FF87" />

==History==
{{Quote|Always better over the water! Are you liking it?|[[Paddy Accu/Legends|Paddy Accu]] to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
[[Paddy Accu/Legends|Paddy Accu]], the caretaker of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[Boat/Legends|boats]] and [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] for the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]], and on numerous occasions transported the young [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]] to the lake retreat aboard his Gondola Speeder. [[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years later]], Padmé returned, in the company of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and again experienced a ride aboard Accu's watercraft.<ref name="FF87" /> The mischevious caretaker initially worried the pair by dropping the speeder into the water before kicking in the accelerator, letting the vessel bounce across the waves. The expert driver kept the vessel from tipping as he crested the waves, and ultimately delivered the pair to the island dock where Accu tied up the speeder.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]] reached Varykino aboard a gondola speeder, finding [[Ryoo Thule]] murdered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]]. Their foe fled in his gondola, but was pursued by Olin, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to leap onto the speeder. The pair fought, while Olin's allies approached in other gondolas, though Malorum used a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] to destroy the pursuing vessels. An [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] arrived to attack the remaining gondolas, and spirited Malorum away from the skirmish.<ref name="DoN">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gondola Speeder was created for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], although the vessel appears in only one shot of the finished film.
